mapper.select: SELECT q.no, q.title, q.is_active, q.created_at, a.post_no FROM question_post q LEFT JOIN answer_post a ON a.post_no = q.no ORDER BY q.created_at desc

SELECT q.no, q.writer_ip, q.post_pw, q.title, q.text, q.is_active, q.created_at,
a.post_no, a.admin_id, a.answered_text, a.answered_at FROM question_post q LEFT JOIN answer_post a ON a.post_no = q.no WHERE q.no = #{no}
